1.name: Fighting Style
1.description: You gain a Fighting Style feat of your choice. The chosen style modifies your attack rolls, damage, or AC depending on the option.

options.name: Archery
options.description: You gain a +2 bonus to attack rolls you make with ranged weapons.

options.name: Defense
options.description: While you are wearing armor, you gain a +1 bonus to AC.

options.name: Dueling
options.description: When you are wielding a melee weapon in one hand and no other weapons, you gain a +2 bonus to damage rolls with that weapon.

options.name: Great Weapon Fighting
options.description: When you roll a 1 or 2 on a damage die for an attack you make with a melee weapon that you are wielding with two hands, you can reroll the die and must use the new roll. The weapon must have the two-handed or versatile property.

options.name: Two-Weapon Fighting
options.description: When you engage in two-weapon fighting, you can add your ability modifier to the damage of the second attack.

1.name: Second Wind
1.description: You can use a Bonus Action to regain Hit Points equal to 1d10 plus your Fighter level.

1.name: Weapon Mastery
1.description: Your training with weapons lets you exploit each weapon's unique properties. You gain the Mastery property of three Simple or Martial weapons of your choice. Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can practice with different weapons and change one of those weapon choices.

selection.prompt: Choose 3 weapons whose Mastery property you can use

2.name: Action Surge
2.description: Once per Short or Long Rest, take one additional action on your turn.

3.name: Martial Archetype
3.description: Choose a subclass that shapes your fighting style for the rest of your career.

4.name: Ability Score Improvement
4.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each. No score may exceed 20.

subclasses.name: Champion
subclasses.description: A Fighter who focuses on raw physical power honed to deadly perfection. The simplicity of the archetype makes it ideal for newcomers, while still offering elite martial output.

3.name: Improved Critical
3.description: Your weapon attacks score a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20.

7.name: Remarkable Athlete
7.description: You can add half your proficiency bonus (rounded up) to any Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution check you make that doesn't already use your proficiency bonus. In addition, when you make a running long jump, the distance you can cover increases by a number of feet equal to your Strength modifier.

10.name: Additional Fighting Style
10.description: You can choose a second option from the Fighting Style class feature.

options.name: Archery
options.description: +2 bonus to attack rolls with ranged weapons.

options.name: Defense
options.description: While wearing armor, +1 bonus to AC.

options.name: Dueling
options.description: +2 damage when wielding a melee weapon in one hand with no other weapons.

options.name: Great Weapon Fighting
options.description: Reroll 1s and 2s on damage dice with two-handed melee weapons.

options.name: Two-Weapon Fighting
options.description: Add your ability modifier to the damage of the second attack when two-weapon fighting.

15.name: Superior Critical
15.description: Your weapon attacks score a critical hit on a roll of 18-20.

18.name: Survivor
18.description: At the start of each of your turns, you regain hit points equal to 5 + your Constitution modifier if you have no more than half of your hit points left. You don't gain this benefit if you have 0 hit points.

1.name: Spellcasting
1.description: You know three cantrips and have a spellbook with six 1st-level spells.

1.name: Arcane Recovery
1.description: Once per day after a Short Rest, recover expended spell slots up to half your Wizard level.

1.name: Expertise
1.description: Choose two of your skill proficiencies. Your proficiency bonus is doubled for any ability check you make that uses either of the chosen proficiencies. At level 6, you gain Expertise in two more skill proficiencies.

1.name: Sneak Attack
1.description: Once per turn, you can deal extra damage to a creature you hit with an attack roll if you have Advantage on the roll and the attack uses a Finesse or Ranged weapon. You don't need Advantage if an ally is within 5 feet of the target, the ally isn't Incapacitated, and you don't have Disadvantage. The extra damage matches the weapon's damage type and scales with your rogue level.

1.name: Thieves' Cant
1.description: You know Thieves' Cant — a secret mix of dialect, jargon, and code that allows you to hide messages in seemingly normal conversation. You also know one other language of your choice.

1.name: Weapon Mastery
1.description: Your training with weapons lets you exploit each weapon's unique properties. You gain the Mastery property of two Simple or Martial weapons of your choice with which you have proficiency. Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can practice with different weapons and change one of those weapon choices.

selection.prompt: Choose 2 weapons whose Mastery property you can use

2.name: Cunning Action
2.description: On your turn, you can take one of the following as a Bonus Action: Dash, Disengage, or Hide.

3.name: Rogue Subclass
3.description: Choose a subclass that shapes your roguish style for the rest of your career.

3.name: Steady Aim
3.description: As a Bonus Action, give yourself Advantage on your next attack roll this turn. You can only use this if you haven't moved this turn, and after using it your Speed is 0 until the end of the turn.

4.name: Ability Score Improvement
4.description: Gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat for which you qualify. Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each. No score may exceed 20.

5.name: Cunning Strike
5.description: When you deal Sneak Attack damage, you can add one Cunning Strike effect by forgoing the listed number of Sneak Attack dice (DC = 8 + DEX mod + Proficiency Bonus). Initial options: Poison (1d6) — Con save or Poisoned for 1 minute; Trip (1d6) — Dex save or Prone (Large or smaller); Withdraw (1d6) — move up to half Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

5.name: Uncanny Dodge
5.description: When a visible attacker hits you, use your Reaction to halve the damage (round down).

6.name: Expertise
6.description: Gain Expertise in two more skill proficiencies of your choice.

selection.prompt: Choose 2 more skill proficiencies for Expertise

7.name: Evasion
7.description: When subjected to an effect that allows a Dexterity saving throw for half damage, you take no damage on a success and half damage on a failure. You can't use this while Incapacitated.

7.name: Reliable Talent
7.description: When making an ability check using a skill or tool proficiency, treat a d20 roll of 9 or lower as a 10.

8.name: Ability Score Improvement
8.description: Gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat for which you qualify.

10.name: Ability Score Improvement
10.description: Gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat for which you qualify.

11.name: Improved Cunning Strike
11.description: You can use up to two Cunning Strike effects when dealing Sneak Attack damage, paying the die cost for each.

12.name: Ability Score Improvement
12.description: Gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat for which you qualify.

14.name: Devious Strikes
14.description: You learn new Cunning Strike options: Daze (2d6) — Con save or on its next turn it can only do one of move, action, or bonus action; Knock Out (6d6) — Con save or Unconscious for 1 minute (repeats save each turn); Obscure (3d6) — Dex save or Blinded until the end of its next turn.

15.name: Slippery Mind
15.description: You gain proficiency in Wisdom and Charisma saving throws.

16.name: Ability Score Improvement
16.description: Gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat for which you qualify.

18.name: Elusive
18.description: No attack roll can have Advantage against you unless you have the Incapacitated condition.

19.name: Epic Boon
19.description: Gain an Epic Boon feat or another feat for which you qualify.

20.name: Stroke of Luck
20.description: If you fail a D20 Test, you can turn the roll into a 20. Once you use this feature, you can't do so again until you finish a Short or Long Rest.

subclasses.name: Thief
subclasses.description: A classic adventurer who hunts for treasure. Thieves are skilled at climbing, jumping, using items quickly, and eventually attuning to more magic items than usual.

3.name: Fast Hands
3.description: As a Bonus Action, you can do one of the following: make a Sleight of Hand check to pick a lock, disarm a trap, or pick a pocket; take the Utilize action; or take the Magic action to use a magic item that requires it.

3.name: Second-Story Work
3.description: Climber: You gain a Climb Speed equal to your Speed. Jumper: Determine jump distance using your Dexterity rather than Strength.

9.name: Supreme Sneak
9.description: You learn the Stealth Attack Cunning Strike option. When you deal Sneak Attack damage and have the Hide action's Invisible condition, this attack doesn't end that condition if you end the turn behind Three-Quarters Cover or Total Cover. Cost: 1d6.

13.name: Use Magic Device
13.description: Attunement: You can attune to up to four magic items at once. Charges: When using a magic item property that expends charges, roll 1d6. On a 6, use it without expending charges. Scrolls: You can use any Spell Scroll, using Intelligence as your spellcasting ability. Cantrips and level 1 spells work reliably; for higher levels, succeed on an Intelligence (Arcana) check (DC 10 + spell level) or the scroll disintegrates.

17.name: Thief's Reflexes
17.description: You take two turns during the first round of any combat. Your first turn is at your normal Initiative; your second turn is at Initiative minus 10.

1.name: Rage
1.description: You can enter a Rage as a Bonus Action. While raging, melee weapon attacks you make with Strength deal extra damage (Rage Damage). The Rage lasts up to 10 rounds and ends early if you don't attack or take damage on your turn.

1.name: Unarmored Defense
1.description: While you aren't wearing armor, your AC equals 10 + your Dexterity modifier + your Constitution modifier. You can use a Shield and still gain this benefit.
